text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a fan event being held today in the lead-up to the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A huge, once-in-a-decade movement is taking place in the Umamusume world this year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's her. That's Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, she looks intense…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are people scared of me? But why?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: It's Oguri Cap! She's here!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: O-gu-ri! O-gu-ri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What's happening?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: If you'll allow me to begin, let's start with the red-hot Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: How does it feel to race with such a monumental obstacle, Oguri Cap the "Hero," standing in your way?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Obstacle? Hero?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, I'll do my best? Is that good enough?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: And over here, we have Oguri Cap charging in to attack from the countryside! You're already a national superstar.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Fall is finally upon us. Can you hear the cheers from your fans?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I hear them. When I'm not asleep, that is.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: O-gu-ri! O-gu-ri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hold on… Are you telling me that everyone sees me as the villain?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can feel it from the crowds in the stands… Oguri Cap's popularity is out of this world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek might be playing the antihero in this story.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's almost like that time at the spring Classics. Everyone was so cold and distant because I was ill.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Actually… could you leave this to me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I've got an idea of my own. I'll try saying it in front of everyone. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone! If you think Oguri's the strongest around, then you're sorely mistaken! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I, Super Creek, along with my trainer, will knock Oguri down a peg at the autumn Tenno Sho! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm. You'll make a worthy opponent, Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's throw everything we have at each other. But I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: O-gu-ri! O-gu-ri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask Super Creek where her confident outburst came from.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Umm, it kind of occurred to me that saying things like that would make everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I wanted to do that for them since I love making everyone smile.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And if I can do that through racing, then I don't mind taking a bit of flak.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I didn't have the composure during my bad spell, but I can handle it now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Especially since you've built me up so much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's decided to play the villain for her fans—the kindest villain in the world.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, also… Would you mind playing the villain with me? And then…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's finish the race with a result so great that everyone can't help but to detest us. It won't be exciting unless we're formidable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek plans to envelop Oguri's unprecedented popularity with her nurturing love.
